primary_no_callback.registered_text: Time to First Occurrence of Major Adverse Cardiovascular Event (MACE); Percentage of Observed Participants With Outcome Measure Events During the Study All MACE positively adjudicated by Clinical Events Committee (CEC) in a blinded fashion, were used in the analysis of the composite cardiovascular (CV) outcome measure comprised of Coronary Heart Disease (CHD) death, non-fatal Myocardial Infarction (MI), fatal and non-fatal ischemic stroke (IS), or unstable angina (UA) requiring hospitalization. Kaplan Meier plots of the cumulative incidence rate by treatment groups were used to depict the first occurrence of MACE over time. Percentage of observed participants with outcome measure events during the study were reported.
